messages:
liam: quick question — for /v1/generate validation failures, do we want to return 400 or 422 when the request/json payload shape is wrong? Also how do we mark retryable vs terminal for streaming clients?

maria: good call. my take: 400 = syntactic/parse issues, 422 = semantic validation (e.g., prompt too long, disallowed content), 429 = rate/quota, 503/504 = infra/transient. retryable = 429, 502/503/504. 4xx not retryable except maybe 409 for concurrency?

aj: +1 to maria. only nuance: some clients treat 422 same as 400, so we should document examples. also streaming: if partial tokens were emitted and connection dies, server should return non-retryable final error if model considered done? we need clarity.

sam: from product/clients: we have two consumer classes — interactive UIs (low-latency, retry less) and batch jobs (retry aggressive). suggestion: add an "error.retryable" boolean to error envelope for clients that want explicit guidance.

liam: ok — exposing retryable flag sounds helpful and backward-compatible if optional. is there an existing error envelope?

maria: yes, current envelope is {"error":{"type":"...","message":"...","code":123}}. proposal patch: add optional "retryable": true/false and "hint":"quota|validation|backend"

aj: snippet for spec: ```json
{"error":{"type":"validation_error","message":"prompt too long","code":4221,"retryable":false,"hint":"validation"}}
```

liam: nice. question about breaking changes: can we add retryable to all responses without bumping major? i think yes since optional. confirm?

sam: yes optional fields are non-breaking. just update SDKs to look for it. i'll add a small PR to api-spec and docs. pinging @deploy-bot to open PR checklist.

deploy-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/api-spec/pull/219 — adds error.retryable + hints. CI: pending. :rocket:

maria: one more edge-case — what about validation that depends on model version (e.g., new tokenizer causing different length checks)? we should tie validation errors to model-version in metadata so clients can correlate. maybe add "model_version" in error context.

aj: agree. include optional "context": {"model":"redwood-aug24","model_version":"v2.1"} in envelope.

liam: action items: 1) sam to land PR with optional retryable & hint + context 2) docs to add table mapping codes->retry guidance 3) runtime to ensure 429/5xx are set correctly. if anyone sees any blockers shout here.

sam: on it, will link PR to this thread and add unit tests for streaming partial failures.

maria: thanks — this should make client behavior less fuzzy. :thumbsup:
